structured.approach: FE-01 checks only whether the repository is available and writable, so I did the checks directly instead of using a helper. I read feat.tasks and org.engineering_stack to find the Frontend lane's task and repository: TSK-07 in ap_portal. FE-01 does not allow shell commands, so availability, branch, clean tree and write access come from the step's tool view. I backed those up by reading these repository files with Read: .git/HEAD, the branch logs for feature/story, dev and main, package.json, ci.mjs, CLAUDE.md, src/ap_portal/index.js and tests/portal.test.js. Every file:ap_portal citation in the output is one of these. I wrote the whole output file again. It has no attempt numbers and no spine-only sections, and it leaves out the personal data in the git logs. I needed no connectors.

claims.text: The Frontend lane owns one task, TSK-07 (STORY-07), in the ap_portal repository; it depends only on the CT-1 field list, not on TSK-06 code.
Repository ap_portal is available locally; no repository creation is needed.
The working branch feature/story is checked out and was created from dev at commit ff761ee; local dev and main point to the same commit.
The agent identity has write access and the working tree is clean.
No Databricks workspace or database is used by ap_portal.
ap_portal is Node.js 22 CommonJS with node:test; CI is `node ci.mjs` and enforces line coverage >= 90 plus static checks (no console.log or eval(, lines at most 140 characters).
Current version is 2.3.0 in both src/ap_portal/index.js (VERSION) and package.json; current exports are VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount, renderAgingSummary.
Existing tests in tests/portal.test.js are 'formats amounts with two decimals' and 'renders every bucket in order'; they load the package via require('ap_portal').
All files in TSK-07's budget (src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json, tests/portal.test.js) already exist in the checkout.
Commit messages start with the story ID (STORY-07); the task ID may follow.

open_questions: RAQ-1 (non-blocking): feat.tasks and ap_portal/CLAUDE.md name the branch pattern feature/<story>, but the branch provided is feature/story rather than feature/STORY-07. Interim answer: work on feature/story as the spine provided; commits carry STORY-07. Owner: Developer.
structured.summary: ap_portal, the only repository the Frontend lane needs (TSK-07 / STORY-07), is available locally and the agent has write access. Branch feature/story is checked out from dev at ff761ee, the working tree is clean, and no repository creation, Databricks or database is needed. The output also records the CI binding (node ci.mjs, coverage >= 90), the current version 2.3.0 in index.js and package.json, the current exports and the two existing tests. All three files TSK-07 will change already exist. One non-blocking question remains about the generic branch name.
